title: PROTECTED_FILES does not guard src/validate/rpg_foundation_validator.ts, tests/regression/rpg_foundation_negative_corpus.test.ts or content/broken-fix
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

The fix belongs in scripts/verify-integrity.ts, outside my ownership. The finding reads correct: the guard's own 'guard both or guarding either is theatre' comment applies verbatim, since a cycle could weaken a foundation check and edit the matching foundation_*.yaml fixture with no VERIFIER_TOUCHED and unchanged case/assertion counts. Whoever owns scripts/ should add all three entries.
